items.title: All three long forms — ready to send today
items.context: All three Florida interviews, native camera framing as you ruled, two-lav treated audio on every one. Both lavs were running for the Sep 12 interviews too, so they get the same treatment Eduardo's got. Sync was measured on each, never taken from filenames. Cross-check that gives me confidence: on BOTH Sep 12 clips the two recorders' anchors differ by exactly 5.85s, consistent to 5 milliseconds. Two independent measurements agreeing that closely is not luck.
items.ask: Spot-check each one - open it, jump to a few points, confirm the audio is in sync and sounds right. Then they go to Dropbox. Also: tell me which speaker is Dr. Perajoc on the Sep 12 clips so I can label TX03/TX04 properly.
